reports.title: Semtech Announces Third Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Results

desk.headline: Record revenue up 58% to $423.0m and adjusted EPS of $1.17 beat estimates; Q4 outlook of $480m above estimates
results: Net sales rose 58% to a record $423.0m (24% higher than last quarter), ahead of the $416.4m estimate.
Adjusted EPS of $1.17 beat the $1.13 estimate; GAAP EPS was $0.97, including a $10.9m investment gain, versus a small loss a year ago.
Signal Integrity, home of the data-centre chips, more than doubled to $182.4m; Analog Mixed Signal and Wireless grew 38% and IoT systems 21%.
Adjusted operating margin hit a record 33.0%, up from 20.6%, as sales grew much faster than costs.
Free cash flow was $55.5m; the cellular module business is now held for sale, with the deal expected to close in Q4.

guidance.summary: For Q4 (a 14-week quarter to 31 Jan 2027) Semtech expects sales of $480m ± $5m and adjusted EPS of $1.33 ± $0.03, both above analyst estimates. The outlook still includes the cellular module business for the full quarter.

points: CEO Hong Hou said data-centre revenue was $145m, up 158% from a year ago, and should top $1bn in fiscal 2028.
The CFO expects Q4 data-centre revenue to rise about 40% from Q3.
A first cloud giant is ramping 1.6T active copper cables, and a second has picked another Semtech copper product.
LoRa revenue hit a record $68m, up 69% from a year ago.
Management said foundry supply is not a limit and the long-term gross margin goal is 70%, with laser ramp costs a near-term drag.
